title: Wild, Recast
concept: An expressive outerwear piece, digitally rebuilt through texture, surface, and silhouette.
description: This project is a digital remake of Desigual’s “Animal Fur” coat, recreated with a focus on surface realism and material interpretation. The animal-inspired fur pattern was rebuilt manually to closely match the original campaign imagery, while the fur texture, pile length, and overall finish were carefully adjusted to achieve a more faithful visual result. The front buttons were also remodelled separately in Blender to reflect the original design more accurately.

construction.fit: Straight, longline fit with a clean vertical silhouette. The coat falls close to the body while maintaining a structured outerwear proportion.
construction.collar: Classic rounded collar with a simple, clean neckline. The collar structure reinforces the coat’s tailored appearance.
construction.pockets: Visible pockets are featured on the rendered version. The design remains visually clean across the front.
construction.seams: Construction lines are kept minimal for a polished finish. Front closure, collar and structural seams remain discreet, with very subtle visible stitching.
construction.fabric: The coat is interpreted through a faux-fur-inspired surface with a custom recreated animal pattern. The texture and fur quality were manually refined to better match the original visual reference.
construction.volume: The overall volume is elongated and moderately structured. The surface softness of the fur contrasts with the coat’s clean and controlled shape.

reference.caption: Physical reference based on Desigual campaign and product reference imagery.
